summary: COZA iteration 3 (real 'Made in' origins + hamburger drawer + comprehensive search + manufacturer analytics) tested end-to-end via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass (100%). PRIMARY BUG FIX VERIFIED: GET /api/products?code=5216 returns 7 products, ALL with origin='Türkiye' (previously 'Fas'). Origins are real country values (Türkiye, Fas, Çin, Portekiz, Vietnam, Bangladeş, Kamboçya, Hindistan, Pakistan, Tunus…). GET /api/analytics origin_distribution excludes 'Belirleniyor…' and shows real distribution (Çin 24%, Fas 22%, Türkiye 14%, …). Comprehensive search verified: q=Türkiye returns Türkiye-origin products, q=<category> returns that category, q=<2-digit code prefix> returns matching. GET /api/manufacturers returns {code,count,origins}; ?q=52 filters to codes starting with 52. GET /api/analytics/manufacturer/5216 = {code:5216, total:7, primary_origin:'Türkiye', origin_distribution, category_distribution, avg_price:42.81}. Products have currency='€' and English names. Composition endpoint returns shape {area,materials}. RBAC intact — viewer 403 on /api/admin/scrape & /api/admin/settings; admin 200 with masked proxy key. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport): admin login → catalog shows hamburger button LEFT of COZA logo, comprehensive search box with placeholder 'Her şeyde ara — isim, kod, üretim yeri, renk', NO filter pill, NO category chip row, NO bottom tab bar; product cards show real origin tags (TÜRKİYE / FAS) + manufacturer codes (#5029 › #8415 › #2587 › #5039 ›); 4659 ürün count. Tapping hamburger opens drawer with COZA logo + nav (Katalog/Yeni Gelenler/Analiz/Favoriler/Profil) + KATEGORİLER (Aksesuar & Takı, Ayakkabı, Blazer, Ceket, Elbise & Tulum, Etek, Gömlek, Jean, Pantolon…) + ÜRETİM YERİ; selecting 'Elbise & Tulum' filters catalog to 400 ürün with active chip 'Elbise & Tulum ×'. Analiz screen shows Üretici Analizi with manufacturer-search input + horizontal chips; typing 5216 filters to #5216 chip; tapping it renders KPIs (7 ÜRÜN, Türkiye, 42,81 €), ÜRETİM YERİ donut 100% Türkiye, KATEGORİ bar (Jean 6 / Elbise & Tulum 1), 'Ürünleri gör ›' link. Genel Bakış donut + category bar render correctly. Drawer nav to Profil works (YÖNETİCİ badge, masked proxy 5f30••••••a041, test_database). No red screens. Pre-existing @gorhom/bottom-sheet 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' console warning persists (library-level, unchanged).

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (React 19). Library-level, harmless. Consider bumping @gorhom/bottom-sheet to a React-19-clean release.

action_items: Optional: upgrade @gorhom/bottom-sheet to silence pointerEvents warning under React 19.
Optional: expose a max limit >60 on /api/products (currently le=60) for future bulk validation tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (624 lines): still within budget. Real-origin flow uses db.origins cached per manufacturer_code (4-digit) — solid, prevents redundant proxy calls.

/api/analytics AND /api/analytics/manufacturer/{code} both correctly filter out 'Belirleniyor…' from origin_distribution — verified live (labels list contains Türkiye/Fas/Çin/… but never 'Belirleniyor…').
DrawerContent.tsx filters origins to exclude 'Belirleniyor…' before rendering the ÜRETİM YERİ list — matches backend intent.

Catalog (index.tsx) correctly REMOVED the left Filtrele pill and category-chip row; comprehensive search-input is the sole entry point; active chips only appear when drawer applies category/origin params (via router.setParams).

AppLayout uses expo-router/drawer (Drawer.Screen for index/new/analytics/favorites/profile) — hamburger renders automatically as the header-left native button. Verified tappable at ~(20,45) in the web preview.
analytics.tsx correctly wires api.manufacturers() + api.manufacturerAnalytics(code) and renders DonutChart/BarChart; man-open-factory pushes to /factory/{code}.
Product currency hard-set to '€' from zara.es source — verified in every sampled product. Product names are English uppercase as expected.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused seeded users and the ~4659-product catalog. Did NOT trigger POST /api/admin/scrape (per instructions).

rca_of_issue: N/A — the reported bug (code 5216 wrongly showing 'Fas') is confirmed FIXED. Root cause was origin previously being modeled/derived; now it is real 'Made in X' data scraped from zara.com/es and cached per 4-digit manufacturer_code. Live verification: all 7 products for code=5216 now return origin='Türkiye' with currency='€'.
